implementation_summary: Finished BE-605 after BE-101 and BE-189 were resolved. Earlier preview code (generator, prompt, sanitiser, routes) left as built. Added four tests that run generatePreview through the real makeOutboundFetch with NetDeps faked (connect cuts and flags tooLarge over req.maxBytes, like defaultConnect): a same-site PNG with non-UTF-8 bytes is inlined as data:image/png;base64 with exact bytes; an image over the fetch cap is not inlined and keeps its alt text; an image over PREVIEW_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES is left out even when the fetch cap allows it; a host that does not resolve makes no connection and keeps the alt text. Confirmed the sanitiser removes meta http-equiv=refresh (existing hostile-input test, plus a check that only the 5 fixed frame meta tags remain). The route still requires generate to be injected (BE-190 wires it).
